mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a variant of the eyeline match because the structure is the same - a look off-screen, followed by a cut to reveal the object or person that the character is looking at."
Point of view cutting is a variant of the eyeline match because the structure is the same - a look off-screen, followed by a cut to reveal the object or person that the character is looking at.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the main medium for storytelling in film production."
The camera is the main medium for storytelling in film production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a medium of mass entertainment and education."
Film is a medium of mass entertainment and education.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to suggest lack of energy or the draining away of life (Phillips, pp. 74-75)."
Desaturated colours is used to suggest lack of energy or the draining away of life (Phillips, pp. 74-75).
fib: ______ is a narrative technique that stresses the association of ideas irrespective of continuity of time and space.
Thematic cutting (montage) is a narrative technique that stresses the association of ideas irrespective of continuity of time and space.
______ is a technique intended to create visual coherence in the narrative action.
Continuity editing is a technique intended to create visual coherence in the narrative action.
______ is a narrative device usually employed by a filmmaker to indicate a rapid passage of series of actions and time.
A dissolve is a narrative device usually employed by a filmmaker to indicate a rapid passage of series of actions and time.
______ is a criminal offence in academics and is highly penalised.
Plagiarism is a criminal offence in academics and is highly penalised.
